about: Engine functions that fafdiff compiles but that live in a translation unit the
harness cannot link as a whole (tools/fafdiff/AGENTS.md: Sim.cpp's non-COMDAT
.CRT$XCU static initializer is a link root that pulls 591 of the engine's 941
scripts/extract_sources.py copies the listed line ranges out of the engine
source into the CMake build directory, and tools/fafdiff/CMakeLists.txt
compiles the copy with the engine's own switches (faf_engine_options).
The ranges are written by hand - the script does no symbol search and no C++
parsing, it only slices the lines. Two hashes guard the copy:
sourceSha256  the whole source file. When it no longer matches, the ranges
were written for an older revision, so the run fails and the
outputSha256  the generated file. When it no longer matches, the extracted
bytes changed, so somebody has to read the new extraction
The loop: run the build, which runs the script. A mismatch fails the build with
the hash to fill in. Read the generated file, confirm the ranges bracket
exactly the intended function, put the hash in the config, run again. Never
